questions.prompt: Someone edits AGENTS.md halfway through a session, then you restart and resume. What does the model see for the original instructions?
options: The new file, because the loader reads it again on resume
Nothing, because instructions are not saved
The text recorded in the log at the start, because resume replays what the model actually saw
questions.explanation: The instructions were recorded as an event. On resume the loop finds that event and does not add a second copy, so the replayed history matches what happened.

questions.prompt: Why does minidsh add AGENTS.md as a user-role message instead of a prompt section?
options: The model cannot read system messages longer than 1,000 bytes
The file is content from the repository, possibly written by a stranger, so it should not carry the harness's own authority
User messages are cheaper than system messages
questions.explanation: The system prompt states the harness's own rules. A repository file is input from whoever owns the repo, so it arrives as a recorded message instead.

questions.prompt: AGENTS.md is 40,000 bytes and maxBytes is 32,000. What does loadProjectInstructions return?
options: The first 32,000 bytes followed by a [truncated] marker
Nothing, because the file is too large
The whole file, because limits apply only to tool results
questions.explanation: The loader keeps as many bytes as fit in the budget and marks the cut, so a huge file cannot fill the context window.
